messages.subject: R-SWAT running issue
parts:
Dear Dr. Tam Nguyen and all,

After sucessful R-SWAT runs I'm now facing the following problem. 
Considering that calibration.cal is in the file.cio and that channel_sd is printed as daily in the print.prt file, and that the channel_sd_day.txt files created in the TxtInOut_# folders have data, I'm having the objective function issue, however I've noticed that the simulations in the CurrentSimulationReport.txt are performed very quickly on after the other as you can see below (this happens with any number of iterations):

'Finished_simulation_number 1 out_of 5 on_core 2 2025-01-02 12:46:11.110701
Finished_simulation_number 1 out_of 5 on_core 1 2025-01-02 12:46:11.567772
Finished_simulation_number 2 out_of 5 on_core 2 2025-01-02 12:46:26.912089
Finished_simulation_number 2 out_of 5 on_core 1 2025-01-02 12:46:27.457044
Finished_simulation_number 3 out_of 5 on_core 2 2025-01-02 12:46:42.965352
Finished_simulation_number 3 out_of 5 on_core 1 2025-01-02 12:46:43.55951
Finished_simulation_number 4 out_of 5 on_core 2 2025-01-02 12:46:58.89148
Finished_simulation_number 4 out_of 5 on_core 1 2025-01-02 12:46:59.520613
Finished_simulation_number 5 out_of 5 on_core 2 2025-01-02 12:47:14.989632
Finished_simulation_number 5 out_of 5 on_core 1 2025-01-02 12:47:15.609284'

Enclosed are two screenshots of general settings and parameter settings.

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,
Miguel

messages.author: 95b10776e416d035
messages.subject: Re: R-SWAT running issue
parts:
It seems I found the cause of the issue. As posted in another thread, the parameter ranges were too wide and that was causing the issue.

Best regards,
Miguel
